title: Quality-Diversity Red-Teaming: Automated Generation of High-Quality and Diverse Attackers for Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2506.07121v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Ensuring the safety and robustness of large language models (LLMs) is a fundamental challenge and a critical prerequisite for the responsible deployment of artificial intelligence. Red-teaming, a systematic framework to identify adversarial prompts that elicit harmful responses from target LLMs, has emerged as a crucial safety evaluation paradigm. Within this framework, the diversity of adversarial prompts is critical for a comprehensive safety assessment. However, previous red-teaming approaches often pursue diversity through simplistic metrics such as word frequency or sentence embedding similarity, which may not capture meaningful variation in attack strategies. In addition, the common practice of training a single attacker model restricts coverage across all potential attack styles and risk categories. tldr: 本文提出质量多样性红队测试（QDRT）框架，通过自动生成高质量且多样化的攻击者，克服了以往红队测试中多样性度量过于简单化和单一攻击者模型覆盖不足的局限，实现对大语言模型更全面的安全评估。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Quality-Diversity Red-Teaming (QDRT), a new framework that automatically generates high-quality and diverse attackers for LLMs, overcoming the limitations of simplistic diversity metrics and single attacker models to enable more comprehensive safety evaluation.
